title: Voxelgame features and wiki coverage
description: Base-game features, controls and guide coverage for Voxelgame, with status and source evidence for the audited commit.
headline:
What’s in the game,
and how to learn it.
lead: Base-game systems and controls, with source dates recorded per entry. Find what is available, what is limited and where to read a practical guide.
legendLead: Each feature has one status for its recorded source revision. Later checks name their revision in the notes. Creative and survival differences are listed with the feature.
gapsLead: Practical guides ranked by player need. Each article records its source checks and whether a headless play test was run.
docNotesLead: The audit compared the game’s own README and documents with its code. Where they disagree, this ledger follows the code, and the mismatch is listed here for the game’s maintainers.

features.name: Creative and survival modes (F4)
features.summary: There are exactly two modes. Press F4 any time to switch between creative and survival; your pack, hotbar and position stay as they are. New worlds always start in creative, and each world remembers the mode it was saved in.

features.notes: Creative: instant mining, free placing/crafting, any tool, unlimited ammo, Build catalog/brushes/undo, block picking, flight, map travel, world controls and one-hit animal removal without drops. Survival: timed mining/tool advice, carry capacity, health/food/water/stamina bars, falls, R eat, T drink, X craft, read-only World tab and rest-point respawn. No difficulty presets. Targeted 35cfc2f8 update: ambient temperature has no survival effect; other mode evidence retains its original audit.

Amethyst gorges are winding canyons through crystal-studded rock. On volcanic islands, cooled lava tubes are walkable roofed passages with two open skylights. Other sites include hot-spring terraces, geyser basins, oases, tepui mesas, ice spires, granite domes, karst towers, moraines and limestone pavements.

Volcanic ground has basalt, obsidian, ash, lava rock, pahoehoe and glowing magma stone, and nearby geothermal areas have warm and boiling pools and steam vents. Everything is solid and cooled: there is no molten lava, and nothing burns.

features.name: Automatic weather
features.summary: Weather follows a fixed 30-minute pattern: clear, cloudy, rain, cloudy, partly cloudy, foggy, cloudy, rainstorm, thunderstorm, cloudy, 3 minutes each, blending over several seconds. Each world starts at a different point, and the whole world shares it, so rain falls over deserts too; there is no snowfall. Rain stops at the first solid or liquid block, sounds softer under a roof and stops by 1,600 metres. Thunderstorms flash lightning about every 18 seconds, with thunder after; lightning causes no damage or fires. Weather sets the sailing wind and never harms the player.

features.name: Animal behaviour
features.summary: Farm animals stay calm near you; shy wild species (rabbits, foxes, frogs, many birds, horses, zebras, giraffes, big cats, wolves, crocodiles and others) keep about 5 m away (frogs 3 m) and run if you come closer. Any hurt animal bolts for a few seconds. Many animals pause to graze and idle animals turn their heads to watch you. Deer, rabbits, frogs, kangaroos and jerboas bound while fleeing; goats, deer and gazelles jump ledges up to 1 m; otters, penguins and swans swim and fish stay in water.
